content.title: Dollar General stock surges on Q3 results. So why is still a Hold?
content.description:
Discount retailer Dollar General (DG) saw its stock surge in Thursday's trading after releasing third quarter earnings, as competitors in the space Dollar Tree (DLTR) and Five Below (FIVE) also got stock lifts after reporting their respective earnings results.

Loop Capital Markets Managing Director Anthony Chukumba speaks with Josh Lipton about what he saw in Dollar General's earnings figures and what discount retailers are indicating about the state of the consumer in a K-shaped economy.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: Dollar General earnings beat, shoppers look for savings
content.description:
Dollar General (DG)reported better-than-expected earnings for the third quarter, while revenue came in line with expectations. The results follow strong earnings from Five Below (FIVE) and Dollar Tree (DLTR), which highlighted that customers are seeking discounts and trading down.

For more live coverage of the markets, watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and visit Yahoo Finance.
